exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on Dynamics 365 Customer Service covering cases, queues, entitlements, service level agreements, knowledge and omnichannel routing.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Field Service Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on work orders, scheduling, inventory and mobile field service in Dynamics 365; Microsoft retired it in June 2026 with no replacement.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate developer exam on extending Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps with X++, data entities, integrations and lifecycle services.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on architecting Dynamics 365 finance and operations implementations covering solution design, integration, data migration and governance.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on Dynamics 365 Finance covering general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, budgeting, fixed assets and financial reporting.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (CRM)
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam on Dynamics 365 customer engagement apps; Microsoft retired it on 31 December 2025 though it remains a common search term.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (ERP)
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam on Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps; Microsoft retired it on 31 December 2025 alongside the CRM fundamentals exam.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Sales AI Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification on designing AI-powered sales solutions across the lead-to-cash lifecycle using Copilot and Dynamics 365 Sales agents.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on configuring Dynamics 365 Sales including leads, opportunities, quotes, forecasting, sales insights and sales process automation.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management covering product information, inventory, procurement, sales, warehouse and transportation.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on designing and building analytics assets in Microsoft Fabric, covering lakehouses, semantic models, DAX and workspace governance.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on ingesting, transforming and monitoring data in Microsoft Fabric using pipelines, notebooks, eventstreams and Spark.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on Microsoft Entra ID covering authentication, conditional access, application access, identity governance and privileged access.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Retired in May 2025 and replaced by SC-401, this exam covered Microsoft Purview information protection, data loss prevention and retention.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam replacing SC-400, covering Microsoft Purview data security, information protection, data loss prevention and insider risk management.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Intelligent Applications Builder Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification for Power Platform makers building AI-first applications that combine apps, agents, automation and models.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: MLOps certification that replaced the Azure Data Scientist track, covering deploying, monitoring and optimising machine learning and generative AI.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Multi-Agent AI Solutions Expert
exams.blurb: Expert-level Microsoft certification announced for 2026 covering the design and operation of multi-agent artificial intelligence solutions.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power Automate RPA Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on robotic process automation with Power Automate desktop flows, covering automation design, deployment and exception handling.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on preparing, modelling, visualising and analysing data in Power BI, including DAX measures and workspace deployment and security.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on extending Power Platform with plug-ins, custom connectors, Power Apps component framework controls and Dataverse integrations.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on configuring Dataverse, building apps and flows, managing security roles and integrating Power Platform with business processes.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam covering Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse and connectors for business application makers.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on leading Power Platform implementations covering requirements analysis, solution architecture, data modelling and integration design.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on threat detection and response using Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, KQL hunting queries and automation playbooks.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance and Identity Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam covering security, compliance and identity concepts plus Microsoft Entra, Defender and Purview capabilities at a high level.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: SQL AI Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Certification introduced in 2026 for developers building AI-augmented database applications with modern governance and DevOps practices.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Single 2026 exam consolidating AZ-800 and AZ-801, covering Windows Server identity, storage, compute, security and hybrid Azure integration.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Associate
exams.blurb: Composite Microsoft credential awarded for passing the Word, Excel and PowerPoint associate exams plus one additional Office Specialist exam.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Excel Associate
exams.blurb: Performance-based Microsoft Office Specialist exam on workbook management, formatting, formulas, tables and charts in Microsoft Excel.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Excel Expert
exams.blurb: Expert-level Office Specialist exam covering advanced Excel formulas, data validation, PivotTables, macros and workbook collaboration options.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Expert
exams.blurb: Composite Microsoft credential awarded for passing the Word Expert and Excel Expert exams plus a further qualifying Office Specialist exam.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Outlook Associate
exams.blurb: Office Specialist exam covering Outlook message management, calendars, contacts, tasks, rules and mailbox configuration and organisation.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: PowerPoint Associate
exams.blurb: Performance-based Office Specialist exam covering slide management, text and shapes, tables and charts, transitions and presentation delivery.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Word Associate
exams.blurb: Performance-based Office Specialist exam covering document creation, formatting, tables, references, graphics and collaboration in Microsoft Word.

exams.name: Microsoft Office Specialist: Word Expert
exams.blurb: Expert-level Office Specialist exam covering advanced Word features such as styles, templates, mail merge, forms and document review workflows.
